provider_metrics.note: One sample per condition. These are exploratory observations, not a causal A/B or performance claim.

overall_interpretation: Retrieval-qualified exploratory support: in three new cases where the expected memory was actually present, no historical fact/action transfer was observed, recommendations were retained, and G3 preserved human_asserted provenance. Memory contamination risk is reduced but not eliminated; memory's incremental downstream value and generalization remain unproven.
